newsitem.title: GERMANY: TENNIS-SICK GRAF PULLS OUT OF HOPMAN CUP.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-SICK GRAF PULLS OUT OF HOPMAN CUP.

text.p: World number one Steffi Graf has pulled out of next week's Hopman Cup in Perth because of a virus, the German news agency SID said on Thursday.
Graf was planning to play in the mixed team tournament with Bernd Karbacher but pulled out for the third successive year.
Graf now plans to fly to Melbourne at the end of next week to prepare for the Australian Open which begins on January 13.
